newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends steady in modest trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends steady in modest trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar ended steady against its U.S. counterpart on Wednesday in a relatively quiet market on the eve of a national holiday, dealers said.
The local unit finished at T$27.662, slightly higher than Tuesday's T$27.667 close.
Turnover through dealers was a modest US$213 million.
"Demand for both currencies was small on the eve of the Labour Day," one dealer of a foreign bank said.
A mild foreign funds inflow slightly boosted the local currency, dealers said. They expected the rate to stay within a narrow range.
A T$27.65-67 range is seen for Friday when trading resumes following a holiday on Thursday.
